approved: National Radioactive Waste Management Amendment (Site Selection, Community Fund and Other Measures) Bill 2020
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would specify a site in South Australia for a national facility to permanently dispose of low-level radioactive waste and temporarily store intermediate-level waste.
It would repeal the existing voluntary site nomination process and let the Governor-General acquire extra land for the facility or for all-weather road access.
The bill would also set up a new community fund, replacing an earlier fund, with the site at Napandee near Kimba in South Australia.
Specifies the site for the facility as Napandee near Kimba in South Australia.
Repeals the voluntary site nomination and selection framework.
Allows the Governor-General to acquire additional land for expanding the site or for all-weather road access.
Establishes a community fund to replace the previous capital contribution fund.
Communities involved in hosting the facility, the Commonwealth, and entities that generate or hold radioactive waste.
National Radioactive Waste Management Amendment (Site Selection, Community Fund and Other Measures) Act 2021
